title: Disturbance Rejection Control of a Two-Mass Spring-Damper System
expert_review: A challenging controller design problem involving disturbance rejection and frequency-domain analysis of a higher-order mechanical system.
learning_objectives: Model coupled mechanical systems using transfer functions
Design controllers for constant disturbance rejection
Analyze high-order systems using Bode plots
Apply the Nyquist criterion for stability assessment
Interpret gain and phase margins in robustness analysis
